name: Intent Context
description: Injects relevant intents, recent domain events, and ambient cross-agent activity into each configured agent's turn (before_prompt_build), and provides tools for logging activity and updating intent lifecycle. No active wake of any agent — everything surfaces on whatever turn happens next.

intentsDir.description: Path to the shared intents store. Defaults to ~/.openclaw/intents.

triggerTypes.description: Registry of valid trigger types. Keys are type strings, values are human-readable descriptions of when to use that type.

additionalProperties.description: Description of when to use this trigger type.

agents.description: Per-agent awareness config, keyed by agentId.

recentActivityWindowMs.description: How far back to surface ambient-activity entries. Default 6h.

logRetentionMs.description: Retention window for pruning recent-activity.jsonl. Default 48h.
